EVAL-CT-M1-S1.title: Define Trial Phase Schema and Scoring Contract
EVAL-CT-M1-S1.description: Define normalized schema for clinical trial phase (I, II, III, IV) and scoring contract mapping each phase to a maturity score; include handling rules for combined phases and unknown values.

EVAL-CT-M1-S2.title: Implement Trial Phase Extraction and Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S2.description: Implement logic to extract phase from ClinicalTrials.gov response, normalize to schema, and assign a deterministic maturity score based on phase hierarchy.

EVAL-CT-M1-S3.title: Expose Trial Phase Score via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M1-S3.description: Integrate phase score into clinical trial results returned by evaluate_care_facade, ensuring consistent response structure for downstream chat rendering.

EVAL-CT-M1-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Trial Phase Scoring
EVAL-CT-M1-S4.description: Create unit tests for normalization and scoring logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov response to facade output.

EVAL-CT-M1-S5.title: Handle Missing, Multi-Phase, and Inconsistent Phase Data
EVAL-CT-M1-S5.description: Implement normalization rules for edge cases including missing phase, combined phases (e.g., Phase I/II), inconsistent formatting, and prioritization logic (e.g., highest phase wins); ensure deterministic mapping to a single normalized phase and score with safe defaults.
